'''Hali system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hali]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
